narrationTexts: Confirmed 3 failures, all in `orderTotal`, matching the tax-ordering bug I spotted. Fixing it now.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

The bug was in `orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39). It taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted total.

Fixed it to tax the discounted amount, via `applyTax(discounted, taxRate)`.

Nothing else needs attention.
